mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_furniture (user_id, furniture_id, is_placed) SELECT #{userId}, f.id, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_furniture placed_uf INNER JOIN furniture placed_f ON placed_f.id = placed_uf.furniture_id WHERE placed_uf.user_id = #{userId} AND placed_uf.is_placed = TRUE AND placed_f.category_id = f.category_id ) FROM furniture f WHERE f.furniture_type = 'BASIC' AND f.unlock_score = 0 AND f.active = TRUE
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM user_furniture uf INNER JOIN furniture f ON f.id = uf.furniture_id INNER JOIN furniture_categories fc ON fc.id = f.category_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fc.id, f.id
SELECT id AS reward_id, reward_stage, granted_at FROM furniture_reward WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND selected_furniture_id IS NULL AND claimed_at IS NULL ORDER BY reward_stage
SELECT id AS reward_id, reward_stage, granted_at FROM furniture_reward WHERE id = #{rewardId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND selected_furniture_id IS NULL AND claimed_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.id AS furniture_id, fc.id AS category_id, fc.name AS category_name, f.name, f.asset_url FROM furniture f INNER JOIN furniture_categories fc ON fc.id = f.category_id WHERE f.furniture_type = 'BASIC' AND f.active = TRUE AND f.unlock_score <= #{rewardStage} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_furniture uf WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.furniture_id = f.id ) ORDER BY f.unlock_score, f.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_furniture (user_id, furniture_id, is_placed) VALUES (#{userId}, #{furnitureId}, TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE furniture_reward SET selected_furniture_id = #{furnitureId}, claimed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{rewardId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND selected_furniture_id IS NULL AND claimed_at IS NULL

UPDATE user_furniture uf INNER JOIN furniture owned_f ON owned_f.id = uf.furniture_id INNER JOIN furniture selected_f ON selected_f.id = #{furnitureId} SET uf.is_placed = FALSE WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND owned_f.category_id = selected_f.category_id AND uf.is_placed = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_furniture (user_id, furniture_id, is_placed) SELECT #{userId}, f.id, NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_furniture placed_uf INNER JOIN furniture placed_f ON placed_f.id = placed_uf.furniture_id WHERE placed_uf.user_id = #{userId} AND placed_uf.is_placed = TRUE AND placed_f.category_id = f.category_id ) FROM furniture f WHERE f.furniture_type = 'BASIC' AND f.active = TRUE
